title: Step 8 — propose the FX agreement: 5,000,000 CRC for 37,000 PEN at 0.0074
description: Banco de San Jose proposes the terms of the swap to Banco de Lima. The agreement is created PROPOSED. No value moves; this only fixes the terms both HTLC legs must match.
notes: Gateway: Banco de San Jose commercial-bank gateway. The server validates that |counter_amount/origin_amount - rate| <= FX_RATE_TOLERANCE_PCT (default 0.1%): 37000/5000000 = 0.0074 exactly. It also requires the two currencies to differ and expiry_date to be in the future. trade_id is deliberately omitted so the server generates one — a UUID, despite the trade-a1b2c3d4 form used in the platform's examples. on_behalf is also omitted: the handler hard-codes it to false and ignores any value sent, and originator is rebound to the authenticated caller. Every party identity is checked against the Paladin roster first; an unknown one yields 400 with an invalid_identities array.
